name: Full-Stack DApp Development & Web3 Integration
description: Building full-stack decentralized applications: Web3 wallet connections (Wagmi, RainbowKit), DeFi protocol integrations (Uniswap, Aave), NFT standards, DAO governance, decentralized indexers (The Graph), and ERC-4337 Account Abstraction.

subskills.name: Web3 Wallet Connectors (Wagmi, Viem, RainbowKit)
subskills.description: Integrating browser wallets (MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet, WalletConnect), handling chain switching, signature requests, and reactive contract hooks.

subskills.name: Frontend DApp Frameworks & State Architecture
subskills.description: Building responsive DApps with Next.js/React, handling asynchronous blockchain latency, optimistic UI updates, and transaction toast notifications.

subskills.name: RPC Infrastructure & WebSocket Event Subscriptions
subskills.description: Connecting to node infrastructure (Alchemy, Infura, QuickNode), managing WebSocket subscriptions (`eth_subscribe`), and batching JSON-RPC requests.

subskills.name: DeFi Protocol Integrations (Uniswap, Aave, Curve)
subskills.description: Integrating with decentralized exchanges (Uniswap v2/v3/v4 routers, flash swaps) and lending protocols (Aave v3 flash loans, aTokens, collateral health factors).

subskills.name: NFT Minting, IPFS Metadata & Marketplaces
subskills.description: Decentralized metadata storage (IPFS, Arweave), ERC-721/ERC-1155 minting dapps, royalties (ERC-2981), and OpenSea/Reservoir API integrations.

subskills.name: DAO Governance, Multi-Sig & Off-Chain Voting
subskills.description: Integrating on-chain Governor contracts (Compound Governor Bravo, OpenZeppelin Governor), Safe (Gnosis Safe) multi-sig transactions, and off-chain Snapshot gasless voting.

subskills.name: Self-Hosted Full Nodes & Client Architecture (Geth, Reth)
subskills.description: Running and maintaining Ethereum execution clients (Geth, Nethermind, Reth, Besu) and consensus clients (Lighthouse, Prysm) for high-throughput RPC clusters.

subskills.name: Decentralized Indexing & Subgraphs (The Graph, Envio)
subskills.description: Authoring custom GraphQL subgraphs with The Graph (AssemblyScript mapping handlers, entity schemas) and Envio hyper-indexers for fast querying.

subskills.name: ERC-4337 Account Abstraction & Paymasters
subskills.description: ERC-4337 smart accounts: UserOperations, EntryPoint contract mechanics, Bundlers (Alto, Rundler), Paymasters (gas sponsorship in ERC-20), and Session Keys (Passkeys).
